symbols.name: coordinate label set
symbols.meaning: The finite set of labels, one for each coordinate of the vectors.
symbols.quote: Let $F$ be the field of scalars, and let $\mathcal I$ be the finite set of coordinate labels, one for each coordinate of the vectors.

symbols.name: coordinate label
symbols.meaning: An element of the label set $\mathcal{I}$, naming one coordinate of a vector.
symbols.quote: Each label $\iota\in\mathcal I$ names one coordinate, and $x_\iota$ is the value of a vector $x$ at that coordinate.

symbols.name: coordinate scalar
symbols.meaning: The fixed scalar of $F$ by which the diagonal scaling multiplies coordinate $\iota$.
symbols.quote: Given a family of scalars $\tau=(\tau_\iota)_{\iota\in\mathcal I}$ with each $\tau_\iota\in F$, the diagonal scaling $\Delta_\tau$ is the map

symbols.name: diagonal scaling
symbols.meaning: The linear operator on $F^{\mathcal I}$ that multiplies each coordinate $\iota$ by its own scalar $\tau_\iota$.
symbols.quote: the diagonal scaling $\Delta_\tau$ is the map

relations.quote: A diagonal scaling is an operator built from the linear maps of [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md).
